title: Farmers Protest: Dramatic Standoff Between Cops, Farmers In Central Delhi
description: Farmers Protest In Delhi: Protesters were tear-gassed  amid a dramatic standoff with the police. Visuals showed protesters breaching the agreed upon route as policemen were outnumbered. asr.full_text: Scare gas is being used at IPO on protesting farmers who have breached barricades. There are currently buses that have been parked diagonally on the roads to prevent any movement further however a dramatic standoff is taking place at the IPO junction. This is a very busy junction in the national capital. Dramatic pictures that we are getting to you at the moment of the clash between the protesters and the Delhi police this after Tear Gas was in fact used. This, remember is a very crucial juncture if the farmers reach this barricades they can get access to the high security Dali. This is a big developing point and we're getting dramatic scenes from the IPO. This is the heart of the national capital and a big breach as far as the pre-determined pre-decided route with the farmers union was concerned. Did the Delhi police underestimate the numbers? Did they miscalculate the strength of the farmers? Was there you know a difference of opinion over the route that would be agreeable to all parties So what we can essentially see that the farmers and protesting farmers where have moved Beyond those buses that were put up as barricades This is an extremely worrying development that we are tracking from The national capital ITO means almost 20 kilometers away From the decided route of the sanjay gandi transport Nagar, this is where the old police headquaters is and the latest information that Saurabh Shukla is in fact breaking to us at the moment is that this breach is not a few kilometres away from the predetermined route, it is an entire of a very direct standoff between protesters and the Delhi police. There is force that is being used to speak up. They are standing there with batons in their hands and what we have seen is that there are objects that are being hurled across that barricade and a mild Lati charge is what we are in fact reporting from ICO in Delhi. Remember this presents itself as a worrying story at the moment. If they beat the IPO border, they have entered Lathians Delhi, which is a high-security GVIP area of the national capital. Did the Delhi police underestimate numbers? Was the understanding between protesting farmers and the Delhi police not clear?
